pr_title: Fix minimap capturing events and improve its theme and editor settings
pr_body:
Fixes #45439. This also applies the suggestion about the border around the minimap. I've also adjusted the default value of the minimap opacity to make it stand out even further.

There was also an issue with the resizer icon, it wasn't created properly and it wasn't colored properly to make it visible in a light theme.

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/11782833/105726816-84c2cc00-5f3b-11eb-947d-bd4e2edc068c.png)

This also exposes an editor setting for the minimap opacity in all visual editors. (This doesn't work in `master` due to #43394, but it works in `3.2`, #45448).

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/11782833/105726854-8c827080-5f3b-11eb-8011-6ef7e92e4b55.png)

**Issue description:**
<!-- What happened, and what was expected. -->
The new minimap in graph editors (animation blendtree in my example) still reacts to clicks even when it's disabled (the clickable area seems to stay):

![jumkNKF2I3](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/8841352/105670923-26b5ca80-5ee2-11eb-9b40-75bd5d9d6cd2.gif)

Also, i'd like to request a small outline around it, so it doesn't blend into the background when using the light editor theme
comments:
There's still an issue with clicking renamable fields or dragging node connections behind the hidden minimap
![jkd5I9UPoj](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/8841352/109471431-080e9a80-7a71-11eb-8ab1-df364e5e85f9.gif)

@Flavelius Are you sure it's minimap related? Connection dots on `GraphNode`s are finicky and sometimes miss events. From my experience it seems to be related to some rounding errors, so moving the graph ever so slighly would solve it as much as moving it a lot, like you do in the clip. Might be fixed with #46441.

At any rate, if it's reproducable, you need to file a new issue.
Yes, that's why in the gif you can see it working okay instantly when dragged to the left (outside that area) and as mentioned, even the textfield doesn't react to clicks. I'll open a new one.
